source: NASA FIRMS (LANCE) VIIRS 375m NRT, world/1-day, one satellite per poll: NOAA-20, else NOAA-21, else Suomi NPP (each row's `satellite` says which). Suomi NPP only from 2026-07-04 to 2026-11-02; no rows 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-20 (Suomi NPP returned none and the poller asked for nothing else)
license: NASA open data; LANCE attribution; not for safety-of-life decisions
confidence_model: VIIRS per-detection confidence carried verbatim; archive keeps ALL levels (display filters, the record does not)
cadence: 30-min poll; ~3h upstream NRT latency. Once a day from 06:00 UTC a completeness pass (server/firesCompleteness.ts) asks NASA for yesterday by date and appends rows the poll missed; a day with no file inside 25 days is written from NASA's dated answer (its ledger, GET /api/data/fires/completeness, marks such a day `refilled` with the time it was asked)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
